claims.evidence: Only one plastic trim/panel piece is shown; no way to confirm range of inventory or fitment list from a single photo.
Country of origin/import history cannot be confirmed from a photo of a plastic part on a wooden plank.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened
claims.evidence: These are engine-condition claims (knock, mileage, 'never opened') but the witness report shows a plastic trim/panel piece, not an engine; the claim does not match the photographed item and cannot be checked from it.
Watermark text 'HONDA AND ACURA' is visible but this is a seller/reseller marketing watermark, not a manufacturer stamp on the part itself; no part number or OEM marking visible.

risks.proof: Photo of the part number/mold code stamped on the plastic, or a shot matched against a VIN/part-fitment chart
risks.if_unproven: price as generic unverified-fitment trim part, not model-specific

risks.proof: Close-up of embossed logo or OEM part number on the plastic itself

risks.risk: Mounting clips/tabs may be broken or missing
risks.proof: Close-up photo or video of all clip points and the reverse side
risks.if_unproven: price as if one or more clips are broken

risks.risk: Hidden cracks, warping, or heat damage not visible from this single angle
risks.proof: Multiple angle photos including reverse side and edges under good light
risks.if_unproven: price as cosmetically imperfect/possible stress damage

risks.risk: Seller's 'tested and working, no knock, low mileage' claims appear to be boilerplate engine-listing text unrelated to this part, suggesting a generic/templated ad rather than item-specific description
risks.proof: A photo/video of this exact panel being test-fitted or a receipt/invoice tying it to a specific engine/vehicle teardown
risks.if_unproven: ignore these claims for pricing this part; treat as unverifiable boilerplate

proof_requests: Close-up of any embossed part number or OEM marking on the plastic
Photo of the reverse side of the panel
Photo/video of all mounting clips and tabs intact
Any documentation (invoice, customs paper) supporting 'Tokunbo from Belgium' origin
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a generic Honda/Acura plastic trim or under-panel part, so it can be priced at worst case (unverified fitment, condition, and OEM status); the seller's engine-specific claims do not match the photographed item and are treated as unverifiable boilerplate.
